steps.title: Same path, in 3D
steps.say: Field2d wants a `Pose2d` and Field3d wants a `Pose3d`, so the robot publishes the figure 8 twice.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: A 3D robot
steps.say: Search for `RobotPose3d` and drag it onto **Poses**.

steps.title: Field and camera
steps.say: Set **Field** to **Evergreen**. Then right-click the 3D view and choose the **Orbit Robot** camera, so it follows the robot around.

waitFor.hint: set Evergreen and the Orbit Robot camera.

steps.title: Three sources
steps.say: Drag on **SwerveModuleStates** (each wheel's speed and angle), **ChassisSpeeds** (the whole robot's motion) and **ChassisRotation** (its heading).

waitFor.hint: drag the three swerve sources on.
